First printed FY2026 Enacted; its life starts there (D-9, 2026-10-15): no other bill, law or request on file carries it (searched for '1820(c)(2)(B)' and 'distance requirement': the FY2021-FY2022 bills, Appendix language and laws; P.L. 117-328, P.L. 118-47, H.R. 9029, S. 4942, H.R. 5304, S. 2587, H.R. 9260 and the FY2026-FY2027 Budget Appendix HHS chapters). H.Rept. 119-696 p.396 prints '---' in the FY2027 columns (recorded as printed). Vision read H.Rept. 119-696's label as 'mitation ...' (the page image prints 'Limitation ...'). Its confirmed absences, which rested on tables' silence, were retired 2026-10-08 (owner).
